notes.title: Free Soundtrack DLC! And Major Update(v1.1.5)
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-gIkvIls_f5o/VxD39JGznkI/AAAAAAAABds/7H6QW91iG-YOhwIjEpkcgKTIPkZHJDNIACLcB/s320/AlbumArtwork.png

The Spacejacked Soundtrack DLC is now available! The soundtrack is composed by Sawsquarenoise and consists of 17 tracks filled with chiptune goodness - all absolutely FREE! If you already own Spacejacked, go download the soundtrack now (and enjoy the music in Steam's Music Player)!

https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-ua1B3bcZuGs/VxD4pYE58ZI/AAAAAAAABd4/5m4e7Bot-gM2af4ags9o8mkKav-dh3dZACLcB/s1600/freedlc.png

In addition, we've added some features and made some fixes to Spacejacked:

   Play-style selection added for Story Mode
   PS4 controller support on Mac OSX
   Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Another Minor update! (v1.0.3)
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Even though we're still working on additional features and updates at the moment, there have been a couple of smaller fixes that we feel are worth making live.

Increased Focus Laser Attack Radius
Before:
https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-8zjGUuaXVg4/Vu_otmml12I/AAAAAAAABcQ/s_D26YgbC48YxIjHaQO90Hm_Ii_GULdKg/s200/beforefocusfix.gif

After:
https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-Ddx8DkpyLoo/Vu_otk2SucI/AAAAAAAABcM/lzMqLlzZjuEgPJ4oim8C-G1ZgMx61gypw/s200/afterfocusfix.gif.gif

Added Quick-start functionality
https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-XhRIJfSHZAI/Vu_pLIS0dHI/AAAAAAAABcU/oV88z3cHkewwc5pJS2Id6avgJM7BeF-ww/s400/quickstartwave.gif
This minor addition allows player to skip the countdown before a wave - especially handy in Challenge Mode. By default, you can hold the TAB key (or the RB button on the gamepad) to skip the countdown before a wave.

What's next?
We're working on an alternative play-style option for players who want to have more time to plan and tweak their turret layout before a wave. As for players who are happy with the standard hectic nature of Spacejacked, we are also working on a New Game+. It will take a little longer though, because we're planning to add new enemies for this mode.

To everyone who have played and enjoyed Spacejacked, we thank you deeply! If you can spare a few minutes, why not leave a review =)? It will really help us immensely!

Once again, thank you and stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Minor update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We've just made a minor usability tweak to the game. Players can now load their game from Day 1 instead of having to exit to menu to start a new game, if they want to do so.

Watch this space for more updates!
